en.title: Two Bangladeshis killed in Riyadh attack
en.text: A Houthi missile strike on Riyadh airport left 12 dead, including 2 Bangladeshi nationals. Authorities are still working to confirm identities.

bn.title: রিয়াদ হামলায় দুই বাংলাদেশি নিহত
